subtasks: Place both chocolate bars, the red wrapped bar and the purple wrapped bar, in the left basket.
Pick up the dropped purple chocolate bar from the table with a centered grasp and place it in the left white basket with the red chocolate bar.
Place both wooden animal toys into the middle blue basket.
Place the yellow pepper and the green pepper into the right red basket.
Set the held yellow pepper down on the clear tabletop below it, then pick it up with the right arm and place it in the rightmost red basket.
Pick up the green pepper with the left arm and set it on the clear tabletop just right of center. Use the right arm to place it in the rightmost red basket beside the yellow pepper.
Keep both grippers fully open and return both arms to their respective initial poses.
